correctness.rationale: For the printed 4D system, independently expanded L[(u^2-e w^2)/2]=-a u^2+a uv+b e w^2 and Lw=-bw+uv using exact symbols. Stationarity eliminates E[uv]=bE[w] and gives E[(w+a/(2e))^2]=(a/(2e))^2+(a/(be))E[u^2]. When the defect E[u^2]=0, compact invariant support lies at u=0; L(w^2), L(uv), and L(vp) respectively force w=0, v=0, p=0 using b>0,a>0,m>0. Slab |w+a/(2e)|<=a/(2e) gives the strict support excursion for all non-origin measures. Fractions a=15,b=43,e=5 yield center 3/2, squared-radius 9/4, activity 3/43. Did not infer existence of non-equilibrium recurrent dynamics from simulation.
